description: This file defines the GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO class, a data transfer object in the OrangeHRM system that encapsulates a DateTime value and provides a string representation formatted via a helper trait.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO
classes.description: A data transfer object for displaying date values in a formatted manner within the report display framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with an optional DateTime object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string using the helper trait, or null if no date is set.
